item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00305","case1_error":"Evaluates 18 months plus 6 years as 8.5 years instead of 7.5 years.","case2_error":"Uses all 500 flowers as both the rose count and the lily count, charging every flower at both prices.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly specified duration; the second substitutes the combined flower count for each species count.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00306","case1_error":"Forms beavers per human as 2/19 and then incorrectly inverts that ratio to obtain moose per human.","case2_error":"Doubles the entire unknown toddler population rather than adding eight duplicate counts and subtracting three missed toddlers.","reason":"The first incorrectly constructs and inverts population ratios; the second applies subset double-counting to the entire population in its equation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00307","case1_error":"Uses the first day's total flower count, 50, instead of its 30 tulips when summing tulips.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final total of 680 after correctly writing the expression, which totals 1220.","reason":"The first substitutes a combined count for a category count. The second supplies an incorrect final number without showing an erroneous calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00308","case1_error":"Conflates past and current practice, asserts P equals P/2, and unjustifiably concludes x equals 2.","case2_error":"Subtracts stored sections from the original 40, ignoring the 10 sections already given away.","reason":"The first equates quantities from different times and draws an invalid conclusion; the second uses the original inventory instead of the remaining inventory.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00309","case1_error":"Applies only two halvings over 30 years, assigning the first halving to age 20 instead of age 10.","case2_error":"Evaluates 30000 times 4 as 12000 instead of 120000.","reason":"The first omits a required halving interval; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written multiplication.","judgment":"different"}]}
